personality_one_liner: A high-legibility, fast-entry construction productivity tool prioritizing structural clarity and offline-ready confidence.

spacing.rule: Use large 16pt+ horizontal margins (lg) and generous padding for glove-friendly tap targets. Floating Action Buttons (FABs) should have extra hit slop.

dont's: Do not use blur or glassmorphism on this app. Use solid surface colors and subtle shadows for clear elevation. High-glare outdoor usage requires strict contrast.

screens.name: Auth
screens.purpose: Secure entry point where employees login or self-register.

states.error: Inline text or toast in error color below input.

screens.layout: Screen background uses a subtle photo overlay with top-to-bottom dark gradient scrim. Clean, single-column form with email and password, 'Login' CTA pinned to keyboard. Text uses high contrast. Self-register link below CTA.

screens.name: EmployeeHome
screens.purpose: Shows the employee's current month work reports and allows adding a new one.

states.empty: Illustration with 'Nessun rapportino questo mese' and primary CTA to Add.

screens.layout: List view of cards. Each card displays Date, Work Site, and Hours. Badges show if vehicle was driven. Sticky FAB in lower right for 'Nuovo Rapportino'. If month changes, the list empties out by design.

screens.name: EmployeeForm
screens.purpose: Data entry for logging a daily report.
screens.layout: Single column form inside a KeyboardAvoidingView. Date picker, Dropdown (Select) for Cantiere, Numeric input for Hours, Switch/Toggle for 'Guidato mezzo', Multiline text for Descrizione. Primary 'Salva' CTA sticky at bottom.

screens.name: AdminHome
screens.purpose: Admin's master view of all reports pending approval.
screens.layout: Filterable list of cards grouped by Month or Cantiere. Cards show Employee name, Cantiere, Date, Hours, Status badge (Approved/Pending). Tapping a card opens AdminEditForm to modify/approve.

screens.name: AdminReportMatrix
screens.purpose: Tabular matrix (Employees x Days) showing total hours.
screens.layout: Horizontally scrolling data table with a frozen first column for Employee Names. Columns represent days (1-31). Cells show hours worked. A sticky top/bottom action bar contains 'Esporta PDF/Excel'.

screens.name: AdminManageUsers
screens.purpose: Admin screen to approve self-registered users.
screens.layout: List of user rows. Each row has Name, Email, and a button to 'Approva' or 'Rifiuta'.

screens.name: AdminManageCantieri
screens.purpose: Admin screen to manage the list of available work sites.
screens.layout: List of Cantieri. Sticky FAB to add a new Cantiere. Each row has edit/delete actions (swipe or overflow menu).

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure `react-native-safe-area-context` is used at the root of every screen, so nothing goes under the notch or home indicator.
Do NOT use glassmorphism or blur effects for this app. We need solid backgrounds to ensure high contrast in outdoor high-glare environments.

For the Admin tabular report (AdminReportMatrix), implement a horizontally scrolling layout with the first column (Employee names) frozen. Use a simple ScrollView wrapper or FlatList with sticky headers if necessary, but keep it performant.
Implement light and dark themes using standard Context or Zustand, applying the exact tokens provided here. Blue, Green, Yellow is mapped appropriately.
Employee Home should only fetch and display reports for the current month. Do not show past months to employees.
Make touch targets generous (min 48x48) since users may wear gloves.
Use a gradient scrim over the login background image (from transparent to dark) to ensure text legibility on top of the image.
Ensure all primary call-to-actions are placed securely above the bottom safe area or sticky at the bottom of forms.
